name: BASIC
author: Adam Dunkels (uBASIC), Nucleo port
description: Classic line-numbered BASIC in the Terminal. Type basic prog.bas to run a program from /sdcard/home. Lowercase keywords only (print, if, goto, gosub, for/next, input, peek/poke, end); single-letter integer variables a-z; peek/poke read and write a 1024-cell scratch array.

descriptions.en: Classic line-numbered BASIC in the Terminal. Type basic prog.bas to run a program from /sdcard/home. Lowercase keywords only (print, if, goto, gosub, for/next, input, peek/poke, end); single-letter integer variables a-z; peek/poke read and write a 1024-cell scratch array.
descriptions.it: BASIC classico a righe numerate nel Terminale. Scrivi basic prog.bas per eseguire un programma da /sdcard/home. Solo parole chiave minuscole (print, if, goto, gosub, for/next, input, peek/poke, end); variabili intere a una lettera a-z; peek/poke leggono e scrivono un array di appoggio da 1024 celle.
